austin.summary: Austin, drafting fifth means you waited, and then you struck twice — Linnea at #5 and Jenna at #6, back-to-back. Nobody has scored yet; you sit at rank 1 (tied) of 5 with 0 counted points, all 4 of 4 still in the game, and 114 points still on the table. Your build is people-people: an entrepreneur, a photographer, a farmer, a counselor. Calm heads, warm hearts, real grit. I love it.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Linnea Capobianco is your headliner at pick #5 — rational, outgoing, optimistic, a 25-year-old entrepreneur who says yes to anything uncomfortable and prefers calm heads over paranoid ones.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Nothing has gone wrong yet — but Carter at #15 and Eric at #16 came late in the snake, and this whole roster leans on charm and connection in a game that eventually asks somebody to swing the axe.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Tribes are still TBA, so watch where these four land — Jenna's lifelong-fan strategy and Eric's bond-fast theater energy could look very different depending on who they wake up next to.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you took the very first punch of this season — Aaliyah, your pick #3, went home in Episode 1, and the First Blood badge is yours to wear. But look closer: three of your four are still in this game, all three grading out at A, and you banked +3 in Ep 1. You sit rank 5 of 5 with 3 counted points, the leader has 4, and 85 points are still on the table. That's nothing, Kylie. Nothing.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: You've got a three-way tie at the top — Cristian, Alexis and Kilby each sitting on 1 pts and each ranked 1 of 21 — with Kilby at pick #18 as the outright steal of your draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah at pick #3 finished 21 of 21 with 0 pts and a grade of F, the first torch snuffed this season and the reason you're wearing First Blood.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Cristian and Alexis are both on Savu while Kilby carries Toka alone — watch how that split plays out with 85 points still on the table.

tami.summary: Tami, you had first pick and you built a faculty lounge with a swagger problem — a sociology professor, a federal prosecutor, a baseball executive, a gate agent, and an OB/GYN resident. All 5 of 5 are still in the game, you're sitting at rank 1 (tied) of 5 with 4 counted points, and the leader has 4. Draft GPA of 3.6, best week Ep 1 (+4), and 110 points still on the table. Perfect start.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's hogging the spotlight yet — all five are at 1 pts and rank 1 of 21 — but Sharonda at pick #21 is your steal of the draft, a leftover grading out at A.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Your very first pick, Angelica "Jelly" Loblack at #1, grades out at a C while the other four all sit at A, so the top of your board has ground to make up.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Three of your five — Jelly, Patt, and Mike — are stacked on Toka, so watch how that tribe fares while Rob and Sharonda hold down Savu.

taylor.summary: Taylor, you drafted second and you came out swinging — all four of your players still in the game, 4 counted points, and a share of rank 1 (tied) of 5. Ep 1 gave you +4, your best week, and every single name on your card sits at 1 pts, rank 1 of 21. Draft GPA 3.5 this early is nothing to sneeze at. With 110 points still on the table, this is anybody's game!

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying more than anybody here — Ori, Ana, Brady and Kristin are each sitting at 1 pts and rank 1 of 21, a perfectly balanced four-way haul.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Kristin went at pick #2 and currently grades out at a C, the lone soft spot on a card otherwise stacked with A's.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Ana's tribe is still TBA while Kristin and Ori hold down Savu and Brady flies solo on Toka — where she lands is the storyline to track, along with whether your pick #19 steal Brady keeps justifying that late-round grab.

tim.summary: Tim, you went agriculture-heavy and unapologetic about it — two farmers, an actor, and a medical student, all four still in the game. You're sitting at rank 1 (tied) of 5 with 0 counted points, which is exactly where everybody starts, and there are 114 points still on the table. Charm runs deep on this roster, from the school bus in Puerto Rico to West Virginia. Tribes are TBA. Now we wait.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Lewis Kelly at pick #4 is your headliner — cheeky, devilish, charming, and selling the idea that every blunder is deliberate.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Devin says a single lie sends him looking elsewhere, and on Survivor the lies arrive early and often.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Tribe assignments are still TBA, so watch whether Maggie finds those creative, open, bold partners she's asking for and whether Thien An's empathy turns into real connections fast.
